column1: # exebuild/symbols/tools.tsv - EXE symbols read by the Python tools that look into a running game from outside
# (perf/, shell/tools/, tools/, server/tests/units/live/). Epic 0590, ticket 0593, D202.
# Columns (tab-separated): name, kind, anchor_va, consumer, note. The anchor VA is the symbol's VA in Steam build 4390913
# (DX11 EXE, ImageBase 0x400000). Never write another build's VA here: those are in the local tables (exe_tables setting).
# Format and kinds: research/02-exe-internals/exe-build-table.md section 3; the tools read them through
# tools/exebuild/resolve.py (section 12). The tools also use these symbols of other areas by name: cam_app, cam_proj,
# cam_view, cam_numviews, cam_viewport, cam_wrapx, cam_gridptr, cam_aabb, cam_period, cam_worldh, cam_w2h, cam_h2w,
# cam_grid (shell.tsv) and ses_gvs_vtbl (proxy.tsv). A row here whose anchor another area adds later moves there: one
# row per anchor and kind (table.py), the tools then use that row's name (each tool names its symbols in one place).
